subject: Issues with geom_vline with bar/histogram plots

messages.author: 6e331217ab04e671
messages.subject: Issues with geom_vline with bar/histogram plots
parts:
Hello all,

I have a data frame containing values for a bar/histogram chart. Two
vertical lines are drawn on the plot indicating threshold levels. On
an older version of ggplot2 (2.7.2) this code worked fine, but now
(2.8.1) I receive the following error:

Error in data.frame(..., check.names = FALSE) :
arguments imply differing number of rows: 43, 1

The data frame consists of 43 values for inbound and outbound
directions. If I change the geom_vline intercept argument from
intercept=VALUE to intercept=rep(VALUE,43) the graph is drawn with no
errors. This does not seem correct to me, but if this the proper code
please let me know.

Here is the code that does the graphing that gives the error:

p1 <- ggplot(actualDF,
aes(x=xval,
y=yval,
fill=factor(color, levels=thresholdColors)));
p1$title <- chartTitle;
p1<-p1 + opts(title=chartTitle,plot.title=theme_text(size=10));
p1<-p1 + facet_grid( direction ~ . );
p1<-p1 + geom_histogram(colour="black",stat="identity") +
scale_fill_identity();
p1<-p1 + scale_x_continuous(name="Utilization (bps)") +
scale_y_continuous(name="Percent of Business Day",
formatter="percent");
p1<-p1 + geom_vline(xintercept=green,colour="Yellow",size=1);
p1<-p1 + geom_vline(xintercept=yellow,colour="Red",size=1);
print(p1);
